content:
**Chitlins Con Carne** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Chitlins in Appalachia consist of animal intestines which are boiled down, fried, then served along side a Glowing Resin sauce.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Glowing Resin (1) Raw Wolf Meat (3) Boiled Water (1) Wood (2) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Delbert's Traditional Chitlins | | Chitlins Con Carne (1) | 

Prior to patch 30 Chitlins Con Carne couldn't be crafted in-game as the Recipe was unobtainable.

A community member has submitted an Easter Egg on this topic: The consumable is a reference to the 1963 jazz instrumental "Chitlins con Carne" composed by Kenny Burrell.
